Please provide your application public key by generating one in your zagomail account settings or by directly visiting https://app.zagomail.com/user/api-keys/index.

aiMetadata.description: Adds a new subscriber to a specific Zagomail list, identified by its list UID, populating the list custom fields you provide. Use to enroll a contact into a mailing list. Not idempotent: each call creates another subscriber record, so guard against duplicates if re-running.

tagSubscriber.name: tagSubscriber
tagSubscriber.description: Adds A Tag to A Subscriber.

tags.description: Add one or more tags you would like to add to this subscriber.

auth.description: Please provide your application public key by generating one in your zagomail account settings or by directly visiting https://app.zagomail.com/user/api-keys/index.

subscriberUid.description: The ID of the subscriber you want to add the tag to.

aiMetadata.description: Applies one or more tags to a subscriber in a Zagomail list, creating any tag that does not already exist before attaching it. Use to label or segment a contact; requires the list UID and the subscriber UID. Not idempotent: it mutates the subscriber and may create new tags on each run.

auth.description: Please provide your application public key by generating one in your zagomail account settings or by directly visiting https://app.zagomail.com/user/api-keys/index.

subsriberUid.description: The ID of the subscriber you want to update.

auth.description: Please provide your application public key by generating one in your zagomail account settings or by directly visiting https://app.zagomail.com/user/api-keys/index.

aiMetadata.description: Updates the custom fields of an existing subscriber in a Zagomail list, targeting it by list UID and subscriber UID. Use to change a contact details after creation. Idempotent: repeating the call with the same field values leaves the subscriber in the same state.

searchSubscriberByEmail.name: searchSubscriberByEmail
searchSubscriberByEmail.description: Finds a subscriber by their email address.

auth.description: Please provide your application public key by generating one in your zagomail account settings or by directly visiting https://app.zagomail.com/user/api-keys/index.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a subscriber in a specific Zagomail list by exact email address, returning whether a match was found along with the record. Use to check membership or resolve a subscriber UID before tagging or updating. Read-only and idempotent; requires the list UID and email.

getSubscriberDetails.name: getSubscriberDetails
getSubscriberDetails.description: Gets the details of a subscriber.

auth.description: Please provide your application public key by generating one in your zagomail account settings or by directly visiting https://app.zagomail.com/user/api-keys/index.

subscriberUid.description: The ID of the subscriber you want to get the details for.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full details of a single subscriber in a Zagomail list, addressed directly by list UID and subscriber UID. Use when you already hold the subscriber UID; to find one from an email, use Search Subscriber first. Read-only and idempotent.

getCampaignDetails.name: getCampaignDetails
getCampaignDetails.description: Gets the details of a campaign.

auth.description: Please provide your application public key by generating one in your zagomail account settings or by directly visiting https://app.zagomail.com/user/api-keys/index.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the details of a single Zagomail email campaign identified by its campaign UID. Use to inspect a campaign configuration or status. Read-only and idempotent.

addedSubscriber.name: addedSubscriber
addedSubscriber.description: Triggers when subscriber is signed up or confirmed.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a subscriber is activated in Zagomail (signed up and confirmed), representing a new confirmed contact joining a list. The event payload includes the subscriber UID, list UID, email, status, and custom fields.

Fires when a subscriber unsubscribes from a Zagomail list, representing a contact opting out of further mailings. The event payload includes the subscriber UID, list UID, email, status, and custom fields.

taggedSubscriber.name: taggedSubscriber
taggedSubscriber.description: Trigers when subscriber is tagged with a tag.

tagName.description: An Arbitrary name you would like to call this tag.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a subscriber is tagged in Zagomail with the specific tag configured on this trigger, representing that contact being labeled or segmented. The event payload includes the subscriber UID, list UID, tag ID, email, and status.
